faq.q1: Where do I find my items after checkout?

faq.a3: Every item lists an explicit warranty window. During that period, faulty items receive 1-to-1 replacement or full refund in your account.
faq.q4: How do I claim my Discord role?
faq.a4: Simply link your Discord account in the Profile page. Our ChinStore bot automatically assigns your VIP Customer role and grants access to exclusive channels.
faq.q5: Can I change the email and password for Minecraft (FA) and Steam accounts?
faq.a5: Yes. For 'Full Access (FA)' items, you can log in to the official site (Minecraft.net or Steam) to update your email, password, username, and skin freely.
